title: The Drop of Vienna
author: Marguerite Marchetti
blurb: Silas Delacroix, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
